g.text: (d) Whole change, moves to or from the first locker; one sentence put before the lockers. After the data.
V0 nothing · V1 a pick naming the first-locker item · V2 a pick naming another locker item ·
V3 a pick naming an item with no locker · V4 a neutral sentence
